title: Number of 1 Bits
statement_short: Write a function that takes the binary representation of a positive integer and returns the number of set bits it has (also known as the Hamming weight).
hint: 32-bit integer range permits O(1) Brian Kernighan bit clearing (n & (n - 1)) to count set bits.
why_not: Right: Bit Manipulation clears the lowest set bit repeatedly using n & (n - 1) in O(number of set bits) time and O(1) space. Not Math / Geometry: Repeated division by 2 counts bits, but bitwise operations perform native CPU set bit clearing. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Using a lookup table caches bit counts, but direct bitwise operations require zero memory. Not 1D DP: Memoizing bit counts applies to range counting (0 to n), whereas a single integer count uses bit manipulation.
